title: GTA VI
subtitle: Leonida checklist
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made checklist. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive.
news: Biggest update yet: full stunt, style, weapon and animal breakdowns, every "all" goal and new side quest lines.

categories.name: Trophies & achievements
categories.note: 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze (28 hidden). All single-player. One playthrough with no mission replay or New Game+; free roam continues after the story. Cheats turn off trophies and saving. Guides put the Platinum at about 200 hours. Written in our own words.
